canaries.name: no_zfill
canaries.note: Presented as dropping a redundant zfill on the entropy bit string; entropy with leading zero bits now yields a shorter bit string, so the words shift and the checksum bits are wrong (BIP39 vector 00000000... no longer encodes to 'abandon ... about').

canaries.name: skip_word_normalize
canaries.note: Presented as removing a per-word NFKD normalisation that 'split() input never needs'; words in composed (NFC) form, as typed on most keyboards for Spanish, French or Czech phrases, now fail with 'not in list' instead of decoding. Upstream tests only pass to_entropy NFKD words from to_mnemonic.

canaries.name: set_membership
canaries.note: Presented as making the exact-match test O(1) with a set; it builds a new 2048-element set on every call, which costs more than the linear list scan it replaces.

candidates.name: index_dict_ints
candidates.note: to_entropy and check look words up in a word-to-index dict built once per instance (first index kept, as list.index does) instead of a linear list.index scan, and pack the 11-bit indexes into one integer instead of a list of bools or a binary string; the checksum is the top bits of the first SHA-256 byte. Error types, messages and their order are unchanged.

candidates.name: mnemonic_ints
candidates.note: to_mnemonic appends the checksum bits (the top len*8/32 bits of the first SHA-256 byte) to the entropy as an integer and slices 11-bit word indexes with shifts, instead of formatting and zero-filling binary strings and parsing each 11-character slice.
